G ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement"), made as of this 1_ day of February, 2013 (the “Effective Date"), by and between CHRIST CHURCH, METHODIST, OF NEW YORK CITY ("Owner"), a religious not- for-profit corporation organized under the laws of the State of New York, having an address at ("Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Z East 60th Mgr., LLC, 445 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10022. WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the building(s) and improvements thereon, known as Lot 36 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map") and as and by the street address 520 Park Avenue, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Owner's Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future placements thereof being herein called the “Owner's Building," and said land and buildings and improvements being herein called the “Owner's Property"); and WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the existing building(s) and improvements thereon, known as Lot 129 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map and as and by the street address 43-45 East 60th Street, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule B-1 annexed hereto ("Lot 129"); and WHEREAS, Developer is also the fee owner of certain land, with the existing building(s) and improvements thereon, known as Lot 28 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map and as and by the street address 41 East 60th Street, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule B-2 annexed hereto ("Lot 28;” Lot 129 and Lot 28, collectively, being herein called the "Developer's Land"); and · WHEREAS, Developer is also the fee owner of certain space above a lower limiting plane above the Grolier Land (as hereinafter defined), as more particularly described in Schedule B-3 annexed hereto, and known as Lot 9031 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map (the “Cantilever Parcel"); and WHEREAS, The Grolier Club, a not-for-profit organization organized under the laws of the State of New York ("Grolier") is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known as Lot 31 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 47 East 60th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Schedule C annexed hereto and made a part hereof ( the “Grolier Land");
